title: Al-Layl 92:1-7 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Layl 92:1-7 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 9. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ (١) وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ (٢) وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ (٣) إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ (٤) فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ (٥) وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ (٦) فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ (٧)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: By the night when it covers
And [by] the day when it appears
And [by] He who created the male and female,
As for he who gives and fears Allah
We will ease him toward ease.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Clear noon, then a heavy ط
Full mouth; the د stays light

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Layl 92:1-7 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 92:1-7 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: «يَغْشَىٰ» starts with a heavy letter. Which?
Listening rota: today's group recites 92:1-7 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, circle every heavy letter in 92:1 to 7.
Explain in one sentence what 'your efforts are diverse' (92:4) means.
questions.a: People work towards different things: some for good, some for bad.

questions.q: 92:5 to 7 say Allah will ease the way of the one who ...
questions.a: A) gives and fears Allah. 92:5 to 7: the one who gives, fears Allah and believes in the best reward. Keeping money back is the opposite, in 92:8.

questions.q: Al-Layl 92:5: «فَأَمَّا مَنْ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Night and day are opposites. Can you think of other opposites Allah made? Why might He swear by them?
questions.a: Night and day, male and female, giving and holding back: Allah swears by them to make us think (92:1 to 4).
